fuel_kg.note: its capacity full at 0.80 kg/L (Jet A-1 / JP-8 at 15 C lies 0.775 - 0.840): one density for every tank

mass_kg.note: its empty mass: 0.10 kg per litre of capacity, the published tanks' mean (one rule for every tank without a figure); not published: a jettisoned one weighed 360 lb with its residual fuel (a news snippet, f16net-300), a fuel shop's ~500 lb (soh-tanks); its size 'about 12 ft long, 2.5 ft wide' there

length_m.note: its size: 8 diameters long, its fuel 0.68 of the cylinder (the four published tanks' means; one rule for every tank without one)

diameter_m.note: its size: 8 diameters long, its fuel 0.68 of the cylinder (the four published tanks' means; one rule for every tank without one)

drag_area_m2.note: the isolated store's CD S below Mach 0.8 at a Reynolds number of 1e7 per metre, built up from its design (hangar storedrag.py: Hoerner's body of revolution 0.01969, its base 0.00153, its fins' friction 0.00000 m^2): an estimate by one method for every store

munk_volume_m3.note: its body's unstable moment across a flow, q x this x sin(2 x angle) (Munk, NACA Report 184): its volume 1.2524 m^3 from its design, times Lamb's k2 - k1 = 0.916 for its fineness 8.0 (hangar storedrag.py): an estimate by one method for every store

side_slope_m2.note: its fins' and base's force across it per radian of crossflow, over the dynamic pressure (hangar storedrag.py: one fin pair's Helmbold slope carried onto the body, slender-body theory's base): an estimate by one method for every store

side_arm_m.note: where that force acts, behind the store's CG (hangar storedrag.py: its fins' quarter chords, its base)
